Iron Boulder

Rock Psychic

Paldea · Generation 9

Iron Boulder is a Rock/Psychic-type Paradox Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 162.5 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Speed (124), with a base stat total of 590.
